detail.longDescription: Jitsi-meet's directory structure on their server does not align with apt's new format, which seems to require, for example, "Components" to expand into the URL it's trying to access. So it wants to find http:// download.jitsi.org/dists/stabl e/main/binary-amd64 from "Components: main." It wants to find "stable" in that tree, under "dists." The actual tree is: http:// download.jitsi.org/stable . There is no "/dists," and there is no "main/binary-amd64" directory. Maybe it will accept the docker version, but docker itself cannot currently be upgraded because it, too, uses the old apt sources file format. I have my doubts because nothing was upgraded to match what Ubuntu did, except for apps under Ubuntu's control. The old format for apt files is deprecated, leaving several apps stuck in old versions which may not work correctly now. Great fun. Perfect upgrade. Did Claude tell you to post this *#$@?? # Ubuntu # elasticsearch # jitsi # jitsi_meet # docker # Ubuntu2604LTS
